What to understand at MT12

Module fragments
A reward used for Infinity development. Check the Infinity Workshop to see what each purchase consumes.
Infinity Grid
A progression board for unlocking additional Infinity modules. Plan a path toward something your current build needs.
Infinity Anvil
A system for purchasing supporting bonuses. Choose bonuses around the specific problem holding back your run.
Module copying
Infinity enemies can imitate equipped modules. Adding a strong module may therefore change the threat you face as well as your own strength.

What you are working toward

  • The supplied tier reference describes Infinity 2 and Infinity reached in three distinct regions. Confirm the current objective text.
  • Meet the current module and total-tier thresholds without using the outdated historical totals.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an suggested route based on community strategies. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Inspect your first Infinity module rewards

    After your first Infinity, look for Infinity Attack and Infinity Foundation and learn their effects. They provide the starting offense and survival tools described in the Infinity reference. Upgrade and equip the tools needed for the new enemies instead of carrying the old Era setup forward without review. [S09]

  2. Run a small, understandable Infinity build

    Test one region and watch what ends the run. If you survive but cannot kill, improve the relevant Infinity offense; if you die immediately, inspect foundation, defenses and copied enemy effects. Change a small number of modules so you can identify which change helped. [S09]

  3. Spend fragments toward a useful Grid route

    Review available unlock paths and choose a module that addresses your present problem. A planned route avoids scattering fragments over unrelated unlocks while a missing core tool continues to block progress. [S09]

  4. Support the build through the Anvil

    Choose damage, resistance, XP or resource bonuses according to your actual limit. Spend for a measurable improvement, test again, and then choose the next purchase. The right balance can differ between a farming run and a depth push. [S09]

  5. Track depth and geography separately

    Push to Infinity 2 on a suitable region, then reach Infinity on three different regions. Three difficulties of Forest still represent one region for the regional requirement. Keep a small region checklist so the distinction is visible. [S02] [S10]

If you are stuck

My old Era build stopped working

Infinity enemies resist ordinary approaches and can copy modules. Rebuild around the Infinity mechanics instead of adding more of the same old damage.

I have three Infinity scores but the region counter says one

Check whether all three scores belong to different difficulties of the same region.

Ready to move on?

  • The required Infinity depth is recorded.
  • The regional counter shows three distinct regions, or the current number Headquarters requests.
  • The module objectives are complete.
After the promotion

After reaching MT13, inspect Wave Breach and Era Tunneling to improve the repeated trips needed for broader regional progress. [S02] [S09]
